channel.title: Onchain Report
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades across the blockchain industry.

item.title: HSBC launches RedCoin stablecoin on PayMe in Hong Kong
item.description: HSBC has launched its first Hong Kong dollar stablecoin on PayMe, bringing app-based transfers and merchant payments to more than 3.3 million users.

item.title: Reap adds Monad card support, with Meru first in Latin America
item.description: Reap is adding Monad to its stablecoin card rails, with Meru first in Latin America, where faster settlement could cut issuers’ need to pre-fund.

item.title: Solana’s Alpenglow upgrade cuts finality to about 150ms
item.description: Solana has switched on Alpenglow, a validator voting system that targets finality in 150 milliseconds, giving payments and exchange deposits a faster path to settlement.

item.title: OCC rule leaves stablecoin rewards open to crypto exchanges
item.description: The OCC’s new GENIUS Act rule leaves exchanges able to offer stablecoin rewards, while issuers remain barred from paying holders directly, keeping a key crypto-bank fight alive.

item.title: Tether wins 15 backers for Bitcoin mining software
item.description: Fifteen mining firms will build integrations for Tether’s open-source MDK, aiming to let software work across different Bitcoin mining systems.

item.title: OCC rule leaves room for crypto firms’ stablecoin rewards
item.description: The OCC finalized stablecoin rules that keep issuer-paid yield banned but leave exchange rewards to case-by-case review, a key point in the U.S. crypto-bank fight.

item.title: Omnichain messages: how to recover a failed transfer safely
item.description: A failed omnichain message may be delayed, not lost. Check its source transaction and destination status before retrying, refunding or sending again.

item.title: Coinbase Ireland fined €3.25 million over fund safeguards
item.description: Ireland’s central bank fined Coinbase Ireland €3.25 million over customer fund safeguards and oversight, with the penalty awaiting High Court confirmation.

item.title: When a Manta Bridge Approval Can Save You a Transaction
item.description: A Manta Bridge deposit may need an ERC-20 approval first, but a sufficient existing allowance can remove that extra wallet transaction on later transfers.

item.title: OCC rule leaves stablecoin rewards open for crypto exchanges
item.description: The OCC’s GENIUS Act rule bars stablecoin issuers from paying holders yield but leaves exchange rewards to case-by-case review, keeping a key bank-crypto fight alive.

item.title: Why Polygon Exit Proofs Can Go Stale
item.description: A Polygon withdrawal proof ties a token burn to an Ethereum checkpoint; learn why mismatched proof data can fail and when to rebuild the exit payload.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on mainnet, replacing its 2020 consensus system and targeting 150-millisecond finality for faster, near-immediate transaction settlement.

item.title: Why Polygon withdrawals to Ethereum take time
item.description: Polygon PoS withdrawals burn tokens on Polygon, wait for a validator checkpoint on Ethereum, then need a final claim transaction before funds reach your wallet.

item.title: Polygon Bridge: How Moving Tokens From Your Wallet Works
item.description: Polygon Bridge moves assets between Ethereum and Polygon through contract transactions, with different steps for deposits and withdrawals and fees on both networks.

item.title: OCC sets GENIUS Act rules for stablecoin issuers
item.description: The OCC finalized stablecoin rules under the GENIUS Act, setting reserve, redemption and oversight standards for issuers that take effect Jan. 18, 2027.

item.title: Mantle Bridge: Choose a Route by Asset, Cost and Exit Time
item.description: Choose a Mantle Bridge route by checking the exact token, fees on both networks and how soon you need funds back on Ethereum, including any claim step.

item.title: Four choices when a bungee bridge sends to another wallet
item.description: Sending tokens through Bungee to another wallet comes down to four checks: the destination chain, asset route, recipient address and funds for fees before you approve the transfer.

item.title: JPMorgan brings dollar deposit token JPM Coin to Ethereum
item.description: JPMorgan has made JPM Coin available to institutional clients on Ethereum, adding a public network for moving bank deposits and settling tokenized assets.

item.title: Check a Bridge’s Pause Controls Before You Send Crypto
item.description: Check a bridge’s pause scope, who can trigger it, and what happens to transfers already in flight before sending funds across chains with a simple check.

item.title: Ledger wallets sold by CryptoBilis had hidden spy chips
item.description: Ledger says hidden chips in some CryptoBilis wallets copied recovery phrases over LTE, exposing how tampering in a reseller chain can defeat offline security.
